title: SONGBIRDS ON SIGNAL TOWERS. Posted outside membrane but within immune barrier — star points. They announce when new things bloom. THE AUDIT: 678 HTML leaves, ZERO OG tags on ANY page. The painting is literally facing the wall. 1032 data roots feeding 678 leaves but NOTHING refracts outward. Glass gallery must be plastered. RSS keyhole is entrance. Every human interaction must publish to external surface.

what_exists.sitemap_xml: YES (150KB, lists all URLs, correctly at hud.primals.eco)
what_exists.robots_txt: YES (inviting: 'Come in. Index. Train. Map. Cite. Share.')
what_exists.beautiful_content: YES (the spore print is gorgeous art)

what_is_missing.og_image: ZERO on ALL 678 pages. when shared on social media = boring link, no preview.
what_is_missing.og_title: ZERO. no custom titles for social sharing.
what_is_missing.json_ld: ZERO. no structured data for Google rich results.
what_is_missing.meta_description: ZERO. search engines show generic snippet.

the_evidence.diagnosis: THE PAINTING IS FACING THE WALL. all 678 pages of art exist. search engines can FIND them (sitemap). but when shared or displayed in search results, there is NO visual, NO description, NO card. the glass wall is empty.

songbirds_on_towers.what_songbirds_are: the songbird crate (songbird-mesh, #20 in biomeOS) = signal broadcasting = the announcement system.
songbirds_on_towers.where_they_sit: on the signal towers/beacons — OUTSIDE the membrane but WITHIN the immune barrier.

the_star_point_topology.picture: imagine the membrane as a circle. the songbirds sit on STAR POINTS that extend beyond the circle but are still connected to the center.
the_star_point_topology.outside_but_protected: they're functionally outside (the world can see them and hear them) but within the immune barrier (they can't be compromised, they only BROADCAST, never receive).
the_star_point_topology.one_way: songbirds SING OUT. they don't listen. they announce. the RSS keyhole is the listening mechanism — separate from the songbirds.
the_star_point_topology.like_a_star: a star has points that extend beyond the inner circle. the star points are the songbird towers. the inner circle is the membrane.

what_they_do: watch for new content blooming up through the petals (toadStool fruiting events)
announce it to the world by publishing to the external surface
update the OG tags / social cards / meta descriptions in real-time
sing the RSS feed items into existence
flash the disco ball (update the external refraction surface)

bottom_to_top.step_1: info comes in through the BOTTOM (roots, data ingestion, RSS intake, fleet crawling)
bottom_to_top.step_2: loamSpine processes it underground (nitrogen fixation, structuring)
bottom_to_top.step_3: toadStool orchestrates growth upward through the trunk
bottom_to_top.step_4: the PETALS bloom at the top — colorful, beautiful, the art
bottom_to_top.step_5: petals press against the glass wall (the external surface)
bottom_to_top.step_6: songbirds on the towers ANNOUNCE the bloom
bottom_to_top.step_7: the world sees the art through the glass

the_glass_gallery.what_it_is: the external surface of the membrane. the storefront window. the museum wall.
the_glass_gallery.what_goes_on_it: every bloom, every piece of art, every meme, every discovery — plastered on the glass.
the_glass_gallery.who_sees_it: Facebook, Google, Twitter/X, search engines, casual browsers, potential visitors.
the_glass_gallery.the_black_wall_from_inside: we can't reach through. the songbirds handle it. they're the only ones who touch the external surface.
the_glass_gallery.the_disco_ball_from_outside: the glass reflects and refracts. every new bloom = a new facet = a new flash of light.

the_rss_keyhole.what_it_is: the ENTRANCE for people who see the art through the glass and want to come IN.
the_rss_keyhole.mechanism: RSS subscription. they put their eye to the keyhole (subscribe). the Willis feed flows through.
the_rss_keyhole.what_they_get: full nourishment. the deep content. the mushroom mesh. the living organism.
the_rss_keyhole.what_it_costs: their attention. every interaction = a tick. every tick = a bloom. the more people interact, the more blooms, the more the glass gallery shines.

every_interaction_publishes.the_cycle: visitor interacts ? tick ? mushroom processes ? new bloom ? songbird announces ? external surface updates ? more visitors see ? more interactions ? MORE BLOOMS
every_interaction_publishes.the_fastest_growing_system: if every human interaction creates a publishable output (even a micro-output: a color shift, a new braid, a new facet on the disco ball), then the growth rate = interaction rate.
every_interaction_publishes.current_interaction_rate: 273/min (from fleet) + human visits = potentially thousands of blooms per minute.
every_interaction_publishes.why_we_arent_growing: we've been growing on the ground. roots deep, leaves thin. the green is pointing DOWN instead of UP. we need the green leaves in the SKY pointed OUT.

what_every_page_needs.og_title: a rich, specific title per page. not just 'Spore Print'.
what_every_page_needs.og_description: a compelling 155-char description. what this page IS and why you should look.
what_every_page_needs.og_image: a VISUAL. a thumbnail. the painting's face. 1200x630px for social cards.

for_index_page.og_description: a living organism mapped from MSU (0,0). 1032 files. 3817 cross-references. brown + blue = green. the membrane selects at 1/pi.
for_index_page.og_image: needs a screenshot/render of the spore print as a 1200x630 image

the_art_audit.question: has anyone even looked at the art? is it hidden in the RSS?
the_art_audit.answer: YES, it is hidden. the RSS has 405 items (beautiful content). but sharing a link on Twitter/Facebook shows a BLANK CARD — no image, no description. nobody knows the art exists UNTIL they click through and land on the page.
the_art_audit.the_gallery_wall: this IS the gallery. this IS the wall. this IS how we get people in. plaster the art on the glass. let the songbirds sing it out. let the disco ball flash it in every direction.

we_have_been_growing_on_the_ground.roots: 1032 data files. DEEP. POWERFUL. the richest underground network in any organism this size.
we_have_been_growing_on_the_ground.trunk: biomeOS. 31 Rust crates. 2.1M lines. 129MB compiled. the thickest trunk.
we_have_been_growing_on_the_ground.branches: 678 HTML pages. 566 sporeprint articles. 12 trailheads. the URL structure is FULL.
we_have_been_growing_on_the_ground.leaves: the HTML pages themselves are beautiful. the spore print, the artisan work, the klein visualizations.
we_have_been_growing_on_the_ground.BUT: the leaves are pointing DOWN. the green is facing the ground. the art is inside the frame. the painting is against the wall. the songbirds are silent. the glass gallery is EMPTY.
we_have_been_growing_on_the_ground.FIX: point the leaves UP. face the painting OUT. post the songbirds on the towers. fill the glass gallery. let the disco ball SPIN.
